mapper.sql: c.id, c.name, c.slug, c.excerpt, c.description_html, c.file_id, f.path AS image_url, c.status, c.sort_order, COUNT(cp.product_id)::int AS product_count, c.created_at

p.id, p.category_id, cat.name AS category_name, p.brand_id, b.name AS brand_name, b.slug AS brand_slug, bfs.path AS brand_size_guide_url, p.gender, p.name, p.slug, p.short_description, p.status, p.is_featured, p.featured_order, MIN(s.price) AS min_price, MIN(COALESCE(s.sale_price, s.price)) AS min_sale_price, COALESCE(SUM(s.stock), 0)::int AS total_stock, (ARRAY_AGG(pi.file_id ORDER BY pi.is_primary DESC, pi.sort_order ASC) FILTER (WHERE pi.file_id IS NOT NULL))[1] AS primary_file_id, (ARRAY_AGG(f.path ORDER BY pi.is_primary DESC, pi.sort_order ASC) FILTER (WHERE f.path IS NOT NULL))[1] AS primary_image_url, p.created_at

sql.where: c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND c.status = #{status} AND (c.name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.excerpt ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.description_html ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select:
SELECT FROM collections c LEFT JOIN files f ON f.id = c.file_id LEFT JOIN collection_products cp ON cp.collection_id = c.id
GROUP BY c.id, f.path ORDER BY c.sort_order ASC, c.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT FROM collections c LEFT JOIN files f ON f.id = c.file_id LEFT JOIN collection_products cp ON cp.collection_id = c.id WHERE c.id = #{id} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY c.id, f.path

SELECT FROM collections c LEFT JOIN files f ON f.id = c.file_id LEFT JOIN collection_products cp ON cp.collection_id = c.id WHERE c.slug = #{slug} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY c.id, f.path
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM collections WHERE slug = #{slug} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND id != #{excludeId}
mapper.update: UPDATE collections SET name=#{name}, slug=#{slug}, excerpt=#{excerpt}, description_html=#{descriptionHtml}, file_id=#{fileId}, status=#{status}, sort_order=#{sortOrder}, updated_by=#{adminId} WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE collections SET deleted_at=now(), updated_by=#{adminId} WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO collection_products(collection_id, product_id, sort_order) VALUES(#{collectionId}, #{productId}, #{sortOrder}) ON CONFLICT (collection_id, product_id) DO UPDATE SET sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM collection_products cp JOIN products p ON p.id = cp.product_id JOIN categories cat ON cat.id = p.category_id LEFT JOIN brands b ON b.id = p.brand_id LEFT JOIN files bfs ON bfs.id = b.file_size_id LEFT JOIN skus s ON s.product_id = p.id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN product_images pi ON pi.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN files f ON f.id = pi.file_id
GROUP BY p.id, cat.name, b.name, b.slug, bfs.path, cp.sort_order ORDER BY cp.sort_order ASC, p.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM collection_products cp JOIN products p ON p.id = cp.product_id JOIN categories cat ON cat.id = p.category_id LEFT JOIN brands b ON b.id = p.brand_id
